title: Desktop UI Integration — Multi-Pass Revision Controls, Style Management, Enhanced Panels
description: Integrate all M10 backend services into the desktop UI: add multi-pass revision controls to EvaluationPanel, style profile management to Settings/Knowledge tabs, enhanced cross-chapter consistency display in AnalysisPanel, and context-aware suggestion indicators in ChatArea.
action: Create desktop/src/api/m10-apis.ts with typed API clients for all new MCP endpoints. Add multi-pass revision controls (target score input, max iterations, run button, progress display) to EvaluationPanel. Add style profile section to SettingsModal or KnowledgeModal. Enhance AnalysisPanel consistency tab to show cross-chapter results. Add context-aware indicators to ChatArea/ChatSidebar.
read_first: desktop/src/api/m10-apis.ts (does not exist yet — create new)
desktop/src/api/core.ts (reference: callApi pattern for HTTP calls)
desktop/src/components/EvaluationPanel.tsx (reference: existing evaluation UI, add multi-pass controls alongside existing autonomous revision button)
desktop/src/components/AnalysisPanel.tsx (reference: existing analysis tabs, enhance consistency tab)
desktop/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx (reference: settings UI pattern for style profile config)
desktop/src/api/client.ts (reference: existing API functions like runConsistencyCheck, processWritingHelper)

criteria: grep -r 'm10-apis' desktop/src/ finds the import in at least 2 component files
convergence.verification: Launch dev server, verify EvaluationPanel shows multi-pass revision controls, AnalysisPanel shows enhanced consistency tab, no TypeScript compilation errors.
convergence.definition_of_done: All M10 backend services are accessible from the desktop UI. Users can trigger multi-pass revision, view style profiles, run cross-chapter consistency checks, and see context-aware indicators.

files.change: New file: typed API clients for /agent/revise-multi-pass, /style/extract, /style/profile, /style/apply, /consistency/cross-chapter, /suggestions/context-aware using callApi from core.ts

Add configurable target score input, max iterations input, progress display showing iteration count and score improvement per pass. Replace or enhance existing handleRunAutonomousRevision to use new backend endpoint.
Enhance consistency tab to support cross-chapter mode: show nameConflicts, timelineIssues, unresolvedThreads, traitDrifts with chapter references
Add M10-related i18n keys for multi-pass revision, style profile, cross-chapter consistency labels

implementation: Create desktop/src/api/m10-apis.ts with typed interfaces and API client functions: runMultiPassRevision(text, options), extractStyleProfile(text), getStyleProfile(projectId), applyStyle(text, profile), runCrossChapterConsistency(chapters), getContextAwareSuggestions(text, workspace)

Modify EvaluationPanel.tsx: add config section for autonomous revision with targetScore (number input, default 8.0) and maxIterations (number input, default 5). Wire handleRunAutonomousRevision to call runMultiPassRevision API. Display iteration progress: current iteration, scores per pass, final result summary.

Modify AnalysisPanel.tsx: when consistency tab is active and multiple chapters exist, show 'Cross-Chapter Analysis' button that calls runCrossChapterConsistency. Display results in categorized sections: Name Conflicts, Timeline Issues, Unresolved Threads, Trait Drifts.
Add i18n keys to both locale files for all new UI labels. Follow existing key naming pattern (camelCase, prefixed by feature area).
Verify no TypeScript compilation errors with npx tsc --noEmit

unit: m10-apis.test.ts: API client functions return correct types
success_metrics: All new i18n keys present in both locales

reference.pattern: Follow existing API client pattern from desktop/src/api/client.ts and component pattern from EvaluationPanel.tsx
reference.examples: processWritingHelper in client.ts shows how to call backend with workspace context

rationale.chosen_approach: Single UI integration task because all frontend changes share the same API layer, i18n system, and component patterns. Separating by panel would create duplicated API client work.
decision_factors: All UI changes depend on backend APIs being complete
Single i18n update pass is more efficient
rationale.tradeoffs: Larger task but avoids API client duplication and inconsistent i18n patterns

risks: Backend API contracts may change during Wave 1 — mitigate by defining interfaces in m10-apis.ts first

affected_requirements: M10-REQ-005: Desktop UI integration for all new features
